examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Language switcher: two tabs with a filename bar, syntax highlighting, and copy.

examples.name: WithoutLineNumbers
examples.summary: Same language switcher with the line-number gutter hidden.

examples.name: WithoutCopy
examples.summary: Same language switcher with the copy control removed via `:copyable="false"`, for a decorative block nobody copies from.

examples.name: WithFileName
examples.summary: Single snippet with a raised filename bar and no tab header.

examples.name: WithDiff
examples.summary: Per-line added/removed markers driven by the active tab’s `lineChanges`.

examples.name: WithHighlightedLine
examples.summary: One active line with an info background and leading bar via `highlightedLine`.

examples.name: WithAnimatedLines
examples.summary: Staggered line entrance for website layouts via `animateLines`.

examples.name: Shell
examples.summary: A CLI snippet under `language: "bash"`. A command line has a different shape from an expression, so it is read as one: the first word is the program being run, flags modify it, an operator hands off to the next program, and the rest is data — mapped onto the same code-sintax palette JavaScript uses, with no new syntax token. `sh`, `shell`, `zsh` and `console` resolve here too.

examples.name: Borderless
examples.summary: The outer card border dropped via `:bordered="false"` — for embedding inside a surface that already frames the block. Internal dividers are unaffected.

examples.name: SingleLine
examples.summary: The smallest block there is: one line, no tabs, no filename bar. The copy control is centred on that single row instead of pinned to a top inset it would overshoot, and the line reserves the control its own width so a long command scrolls under nothing.

examples.name: UnevenTabs
examples.summary: Two tabs holding a different number of lines — the only geometry where the shell changes height on a swap. It animates between the two heights while the new snippet enters line by line, so neither the block nor the page under it jumps a whole row set in one frame.

examples.name: WithTabIcons
examples.summary: One tab per coding agent, each opening its own config file with the agent mark beside its name. The `tab-icon` slot receives the tab, so the mark is chosen from `tab.value`; the marks are drawn as a mask so they take the tab text color in both themes.
